attribution: AMI Project manual annotations v1.6.2, published April10,2017; orthographic word timing
timing: Each normalized token retains its official XML word interval; full_segment pseudo timing on both sides. Not sentence-level ASR timing.
normalization: metrics.words: Unicode casefold, preserve apostrophes and decimals; lexical w nodes only, retain fillers. Invalid/missing/nonpositive/out-of-file spans excluded and counted.
attribution_policy: Exactly one unique known predicted speaker intersecting the word interval; no activity, UNKNOWN activity or multiple speakers abstains. Same-speaker fragments may have gaps; no minimum covered fraction. No reference identity used.
abstention_scoring: Abstained words omitted from hypothesis speaker streams, retained in reference, incur attribution deletions. Actual text is not deleted; UNKNOWN is never a free mapped speaker.
qualification: Descriptive follow-up frozen after model DER predictions but before word scoring. Oracle text and timing isolate attribution; not end-to-end ASR WER, production word alignment, a new promotion gate or a named-identity test.
